nodes.label: Donor and Alumni Experience
nodes.rationale: The implementation focuses on donor and alumni workflows rather than a broad marketing-only site.

nodes.label: Hash-based Tab Navigation
nodes.rationale: The site is intentionally a single-page app with section and tab switching rather than a multi-route site.

nodes.label: Database or Hosted Store
nodes.rationale: The README notes JSON storage should be replaced by a database or hosted store beyond prototype/light production use.

nodes.label: Row Level Security
nodes.rationale: Row level security should remain enabled while website access is limited to server-side API routes using private database access or a service role key.
